script: In the NBA, rookies are usually pranked by teammates to welcome them to the league, with most pranks usually involving someone's car, as it's tradition to fill it up with popcorn, cereal, and even remove the tires just to see their reaction. But the funniest one has to be when LeBron pranked his own son before their first game together. *Bronny opens car* Bronny: Yo!? *LeCereal everywhere* Bronny: Cmon... *LePrankster pulling up* Hey, Rook! You better not be late. Yo, are you serious? Come on, man. Aye, clean up my driveway. It's a mess. Yo, you too old for this!
